name: SectionRail
purpose: A plain list of sections. The current one is a left accent hairline plus aria-current, not a filled pill.
behavioralRules: The current section is a left accent hairline and aria-current true. No numbered chips and no filled nav pill.
On a new build, arrow keys move inside the rail and Tab leaves it.
Do not convey the current section by color alone.

adoption.apply: On the named rail, replace a filled selection pill with sparq-mark and set aria-current on the item that is already current. Do not change where the links go.
suggest: Rebuilding the rail into a single tab stop with arrow keys inside is keyboard behavior. Suggest it. Do not recode key handlers during a visual stage.
